{{Top}}
The term '''Arch-Provost''' can apply to a variety of governing positions, often in place of a [[King/Legends|monarch]] or in control of a large jurisdiction.

==History==
One [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known to have an Arch-Provost was [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], having been impressed by the design of the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], Arch-Provost [[Bengila Urlan]] ordered industrial spies and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designers to make efforts to reduce [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat's]] lead for new contracts handed out by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Eventually, these plans would culminate in the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]. Arch-Provost Urlan was additionally successful in luring [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards']] top shipwright, [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]], away from KDY to [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]].
